t: This is the Homeopathy Research Institute, a facility in London. It was founded by Alexander Tournier, a researcher. Tournier matters here because he established the institute, so its existence comes down to his decision to start it. The material I have is quite thin, and I don't have dates for him or details of the institute's work, so I won't guess at them. What I can tell you is that this is a research organisation with a named founder, and that's the extent of what I know.
